italy.title: Flag of Italy

colors.note: Represents the Italian landscape and hope
Symbolizes the snow-capped Alps and peace
Represents the blood shed for Italian unification

desc: - Three equal vertical stripes of green, white, and red, enshrined in Article 12 of the Italian Constitution
- The colours represent the natural landscape, the Alps, and the sacrifice of the Risorgimento
trivia:
- The Italian tricolour was inspired by the French Tricolore. Napoleon introduced it to Northern Italy in 1797
- The green represents the hills and plains; white represents the snow-capped Alps; red represents blood of independence
- Italy's flag was adopted during the Revolutions of 1848 and formalized in 1861 upon unification
